Name: Pizza Farm
Author: AlyaLyalya
Description:
[size=2]Hello everyone! This is my new farm. I had way too much fun making it. And I want to share this map with you. 

So, basic mod (without [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]) replaces STANDARD farm and features: 
* [b]Config Options[/b] - you can choose to have or not a different Farm Cave interior (just to match the outside), early access to the Desert and Tide Pools, sprinklers working on sand or not (Beach, Desert, Island areas). *

New farm house interior and a  different Starter Gift.
[b]Farming[/b]: Basically if it is walkable - it should be tillable! There are 2 fruit trees at the beginning of new save.
[b]Foraging[/b]: Berry Bushes, respawning stumps, a little quarry, beach spawning.
Ranching: start with the blue grass! 
[b]Fishing[/b]: you can catch a mountain, river, woods, ocean, island and desert fish on the farm but with slightly less chances then normal. Also there are some stuff you might catch (like lucky ring, pearl, holy blade and other). Note: you will catch a sunfish first at any fishing area, it`s normal.
It's safe to pass out on your farm.
There are some lights on unmovable places.

(With FarmTypeManager) there are just more spawn areas and dig spots for: pizza (of course), flowers, mushrooms, cactuses and more stuff related to the "slices". If you don't want respawns and digging spots just delite "(FTM) PizzaFarm" folder in your mods folder after unpacking this mod. 

[b]Compatibility[/b]:
[b]Recolors[/b] - To connect the "pizza slices", I had to make a new tilesheet. I managed to add [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url], so it's only recolor that works for now.
[b]SVE[/b] - should work, also in SVE mod config you can choose 'Grandpa's Shed' option that moves the warp point off the farm and custom coorditanes for Enchanted Grove Warp (i might help with coorditanes for specific points). Warps might not work good with the mods that changing Desert and Tide pools locations.
[b]Minecarts[/b] - this is a castom map and some mods that add minecart on the farm might cause some issues. If you have it, try choose custom option in those mods if possible. I know that [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21859](CP) More Minecarts[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11881]Integrated Minecarts[/url] - A Minecart Expansion have this option. So in configs of those mods choose (x 35 y 73, otherwise minecart there is just a decor).
[i]
I wish you all the best. [/i]
If you encounter anything weird, let me know and I'll try to figure out how to help you and fix it. 

[b]Requirements[/b]:
 [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]
 [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
 [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]  (optional)
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098] GenericModConfigMenu[/url] (optional)

[b]How to Install[/b]:
Download and then unzip
Put the unzipped folder into your mods folder
Run the game and pick the Standard Farm
